name: Dragon Realm
corpus: TFT Set 7: Dragonlands (58 champions) plus 2 Set 7.5 Uncharted Realms slots (Zippy, Graves)
theme: The Mega dragons of the Digital World (Breakdramon, Goldramon, Megidramon, Examon, Ouryumon, Slayerdramon) with the X-Antibody knights, the Olympos gods and the ancient stone guardians. Every form uses a Cyber Sleuth, Digimon Links, Next Order, Re:Digitize or Time Stranger model. TFT Set 7 was built around dragon units that take two slots; Digimon has more dragon Megas than any other kind.

mechanic.name: Mega Dragons
mechanic.adapts: Dragon units and the Treasure Dragon (TFT Set 7)
rules: Dragon units (the eight lines with the Dragon trait) take 2 team slots, add +3 to the trait marked on them and gain +700 max HP. The bonus only works with exactly one Dragon on the board.
Dragon lines cost 4, 5 or 6 gold in the shop (TFT 7.5 used 6/7/8 for 3/4/5-cost dragons; this keeps them one gold above their tier). A Dragon can be bought only once per player.
Treasure Dragon: the stage 4 wild round (4-4) is a Treasure Goldramon. Beating it offers a choice of 4 loot orbs with one free reroll; at least 5 components have dropped before it.
Three copies still digivolve. A Dragon line reaching its final form keeps the 2-slot cost.
mechanic.engineWork: Board size counts slots instead of units, a per-unit marked trait worth +3, and a once-per-player purchase flag. The Treasure Goldramon reuses this set's Goldramon model at 1.5x scale.

traits.name: Stargazers
effect: +80 AP; Star Orbs may hold components
traits.desc: Sky and star Digimon. After you field them, every 5th shop shows more Stargazers and gives a Star Orb worth 2/4/6 gold by the tier you last fielded.

traits.name: X-Antibody
traits.desc: Each X-Antibody Digimon gives the whole team its own bonus; X-Antibody units get double. Craniamon X: +100 HP. Dynasmon X: +10% attack speed. Omnimon X: +10 AP. UlforceVeedramon X: +6% dodge. Leopardmon X: +8 AD. Kentaurosmon X: +1 gold every round.

traits.name: Ancient Stones
effect: 1 stone statue: +2% max HP healing every 2s, +15% AS
traits.desc: Place movable stone guardian statues. Allies that start combat next to one heal and gain attack speed. Statues gain 100 HP each round and, when destroyed, heal adjacent allies for 25% of their HP.

traits.name: Data Mirage
traits.desc: One bonus is picked at random each game: Dancer (dodge 20/30/45% and +20/35/50% AS), Warlord (+15/30/50% AD and HP), Electric Overload (every 3/2/1.5s, 120/200/350 magic damage to adjacent enemies), Executioner (+20/30/45% crit and crits execute under 10% HP).

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: Berserk units have rage instead of mana: every attack gives 15 rage. After casting they enrage for 4s (+25% AS and no rage gain) and also get the listed bonus.

traits.name: Showtime
traits.desc: After dealing damage with an ability, a Showtime unit launches a firework at a random enemy.

traits.name: Dragon Slayers
traits.desc: Dragon Slayers take 20% less damage from enemies with more than 2200 HP. If you have no Dragon on your board, they also deal the listed share of their damage again as magic damage.

traits.name: Golden Armor
traits.desc: Grants golden items that leave when the holder is benched: Crown of Courage, Golden Digi-Egg Charm, Treasure Axe, Gambler's Card, Goldmancer's Staff, Mogul's Mail, Needlessly Big Chip (renamed Set 7 Shimmerscale items, same effects).

traits.name: Thunder
effect: Enemies take 5% max HP true damage; Thunder +20% AS
traits.desc: After 8 seconds lightning strikes the board: all enemies are stunned for 1s and take the true damage, then Thunder units gain attack speed.

traits.name: Nightmare Whispers
effect: +1 AD and AP per hit on a shrunk enemy
traits.desc: Nightmare Whispers damage shrinks enemies: -40% armor and MR for 6s. Each time they hit a shrunk enemy they gain the listed stacking bonus for the fight.

traits.name: Digi-Egg Tamers
traits.desc: After each combat every Tamer feeds 1 treat per form stage to your hatchling (a Koromon, from the Cyber Sleuth rip already downloaded). It gains 25 HP and 2 AP per treat and grows at 25 treats. It fights from your bench edge with a bubble ability.

traits.name: Digi-Core
traits.desc: Allies that survive a PvP fight have a 2% chance to drop a Digi-Core; this unit always drops one when its ability hits. Each Core adds 1% to your odds of higher-cost shop units for the game.

traits.name: Copycat
traits.desc: After each cast and at the start of each round, this line copies the ability of a random Digimon in the set and casts it as its own.

traits.name: Wishing Star
traits.desc: The first time this unit casts in a PvP fight, your Tamer heals 1/2/4 HP (Rookie/Champion/final). Healing above max HP deletes a random enemy unit.

traits.name: Assassin
traits.desc: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts; their abilities can crit.

traits.name: Bruiser
traits.desc: The whole team gains max HP. Bruisers gain double.

traits.name: Cannoneer
traits.desc: Every 5th attack fires a cannon shot that hits the target and adjacent enemies.

traits.name: Rider
traits.desc: Riders charge to their target when they move. They gain armor and MR, doubled for 4s at the start of combat and after each charge.

traits.name: Dragon
effect: +3 to the marked trait and +700 HP (only with exactly 1 Dragon)
traits.desc: Dragons take 2 team slots. See the set mechanic.

traits.name: Dragon Tamer
traits.desc: Use the Dragon Tamer Blessing item to choose a Hero. The Hero gains the bonus, raised by 20% per form stage of your Dragon Tamers.

traits.name: Evoker
traits.desc: Evokers gain mana from every ability cast on the board.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.desc: Once per combat at 50% HP, a Guardian shields itself and its closest ally. Shields stack.

traits.name: Legend
traits.desc: Each combat one adjacent ally gives its life to the Legend, which gains 100% of that ally's HP, armor and MR and 30% of its AP.

traits.name: Mage
traits.desc: Mages cast their ability twice in a row.

traits.name: Holy Ward
traits.desc: Holy Wards protect the team against abilities.

traits.name: Mode Change
traits.desc: Mode Change units switch forms the first time they cast and gain max HP.

traits.name: Swiftshot
traits.desc: Swiftshots get +2 range and attack speed for each hex between them and their target.

traits.name: Warrior
traits.desc: Each attack has a 50% chance to empower the next attack.

items.effect: Crown of Courage (+1 team size while equipped), Golden Digi-Egg Charm (+1 gold per round; grows), Treasure Axe (attacks have a chance to drop gold), Gambler's Card (AP rises with your gold), Goldmancer's Staff (gold on cast), Mogul's Mail (HP rises with gold, pays out at 10 stacks), Needlessly Big Chip (+AP, cast twice at full stacks).
